data_issues: No label problems found: y matches the stimulus-log category on every fit/holdout trial, and no rows are duplicated across splits. The eval set is not independent, though. Each neuron takes only about 4-15 distinct counts across the 168 eval rows, so the pseudo-population reuses the same few per-session presentations many times. The 168 test trials therefore hold much less independent information than their count suggests. The eval rows are also shifted from fit (for example, the strong high-count responses of neuron 8 to smallAnimal and neuron 21 to mobility are missing, and neuron 0 and neuron 28 show inflated repeated values), so accuracy will likely fall below cross-validated accuracy.
